generated.description: A large fantasy temple built mostly from stone bricks, stone slabs and stone brick stairs, with glowing lava channels and tall purple and magenta stained glass windows. Its stepped, symmetrical form rises about 67 blocks high on a 57 by 57 footprint, with a pointed spire at the top and a wide base. The build uses about 20,000 blocks and has no block entities, so it is a decorative exterior rather than a functional interior.
